day_shape: 72 items: US-Iran 14-point MOU draft circulating with possible signing tonight, E4/G7 leaders endorse the deal, five IDF soldiers wounded by Hezbollah drones in southern Lebanon, Italy to reopen Tehran embassy Friday, heavy regime-channel cycle including Defa Press claim of F-5 strike on US base in Kuwait.

threads.label: US-Iran MOU heads toward signing
threads.summary: A draft 14-point US-Iran memorandum of understanding including a pledge Iran 'will never produce nuclear weapons' circulated, with Jerusalem Post reporting it could be signed as early as Wednesday evening and Qatar hosting preparatory talks in Doha. Trump said the MOU is 'not final' and threatened to 'return to dropping bombs' if talks fail, denying reports of a $300 billion fund for Iran.

threads.label: Western governments endorse the deal
threads.summary: A Joint E4 leaders' statement published by 10 Downing Street backed the US-Iran peace deal, and the G7 welcomed the agreement while warning Iran must never obtain nuclear weapons and moving to diversify energy away from the Strait of Hormuz. Italy's Foreign Minister announced the Italian embassy in Tehran will reopen Friday after months of suspension.

threads.label: Israeli scepticism over MOU terms
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post carried commentary calling the deal a 'catastrophic capitulation' and citing an Institute for the Study of War assessment that economic relief would let Iran reconstitute military power. Likud reportedly scrapped election ads highlighting Netanyahu-Trump ties following the deal, and a White House talking-points piece was challenged on its claims.

threads.label: Hezbollah drones and rockets wound IDF troops
threads.summary: The IDF said five soldiers were wounded, one seriously, by Hezbollah FPV explosive drones near Kfar Tebnit in southern Lebanon around 6 a.m., followed by further rocket fire and drone incidents through the day. Times of Israel also reported several injured in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon and sirens in Zarit.

threads.label: Hezbollah and allied factions message defiance
threads.summary: Hezbollah Secretary-General Sheikh Naim Qassem said the group had 'shattered' Israel's 'Greater Israel' project and thanked Iran for backing the Lebanese front, in remarks carried by IRIB and Defa Press. Hezbollah Iraq told Defa Press 'the battle is unfinished', and a Jerusalem Post post cited a Hezbollah-affiliated MP claiming Ankara assured support for the group's continued role.

threads.label: IDF strikes on October 7 perpetrators in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF announced weekend airstrikes in Gaza killed Hamas sniper-cell commander Ahmad Abu Hin and operative Mahmoud Walid Jabr Abu Hin, both said to have entered Israel on October 7, 2023. A separate strike killed Hamas platoon commander Muhammad al-Namrouti and Islamic Jihad commander Mu'awiya Suleiman Saqr Ayadi.

threads.label: Regime claims on war, AI and Hormuz oil flows
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press claimed IRGC Air Force F-5 pilots bombed a US base in Kuwait, with a first account to air on Channel Two's 20:30 news, while IRIB said the Pentagon's 'Maven' system used Musk's Grok AI in the war — a claim also reported by Times of Israel. Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel reported Iranian tankers sidestepping the US Hormuz blockade via shuttling, with oil prices falling on optimism over reopening.
